notes.title: Employee Update
notes.content:
The employees have been modified so that they are now coming to work when you enter the game and do not go home until you finish playing

They were modified at the request of the players

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
The warehouse door has been fixed upon reaching the level of 20, it will be opened permanently

When the store is closed, the time will be stopped and when the store is open, it will complete the count time

The price change is now happening every 10 days



Note: There will be an update for the price change system

notes.title: I follow your suggestions
notes.content:
I followed your suggestions and comments and fixed some problems such as:
Fix some errors in workers such as stopping and not increasing working time when Boosting

Fix the problem of changing the store name

Fixed the problem of changing the price and the number 2 appearing on all empty shelves

Other minor fixes




Leave your opinion about the game in a comment on the game's page on Steam.
